Subject: Exploring New Opportunities Together

Dear Crypto.com Team,

Thank you once again for the opportunity to collaborate on the AI Readiness Audit project. I genuinely appreciated the synergy we created and the insights shared during our discussions.

Since our last engagement, Zion Tech Group has further refined our AI and IT services, and I believe we have some exciting opportunities that could be mutually beneficial:

1. **Managed AI Support Automation**: We can deploy our AI agents to manage Tier-1 and Tier-2 support tickets, significantly reducing response times by over 60%. This service could be co-branded, allowing you to maintain your client relationships while we handle the AI delivery.

2. **AI Readiness & Cost-Optimization Assessments**: Building on our previous discussions, we can package the audit framework into a repeatable, co-branded offering. You would lead the prospect conversations while we provide the technical depth, with a 50/50 revenue split on net margins.

3. **Hybrid-Cloud Migration + AI Ops Pilot**: We can initiate a 30-day pilot using your existing environment alongside our platform. This would demonstrate measurable reductions in Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR) and cloud cost savings. Following the pilot, we can transition to a Master Services Agreement with pre-agreed pricing.

I would love to discuss these ideas further and see which direction resonates most with your team. We can refine the scope via email or finalize commercial terms during a brief call. You can schedule a time that works for you here: https://calendly.com/kleber-ziontechgroup.

Additionally, I encourage you to explore the free tools and services available on our website, which your team can start utilizing immediately: https://ziontechgroup.com.

Looking forward to your thoughts!

Best regards,

Kleber Garcia Alcatrão  
CEO, Zion Tech Group
